text: Best soils for cucumber are alluvial, sandy-loam or laterite-red soils with pH around 5-6.5. Land should be plowed at least twice and left to dry/weather for about 15 days before bed-forming, to break up clumps, expose pests to sun, and aerate the soil. If soil pH tests outside the 5-6.5 target range, agricultural lime, gypsum (Ca(SO4)), or dolomite (CaMg(CO3)) is worked in roughly 2 weeks to 1 month before planting to correct it.
